## 提交前 / Before review

- [ ] 已阅读贡献指南及 agent.md，改动范围清楚 / Read CONTRIBUTING and agent.md; scope is focused.
- [ ] 已说明验证结果与未覆盖项 / Reported relevant checks and untested areas.
- [ ] 已按需更新文档、CHANGELOG 和翻译，或说明不适用 / Updated docs, changelog and locales where relevant, or explained N/A.
- [ ] 未包含凭据或私人设备数据，保留第三方来源与许可 / No secrets/private device data; third-party notices retained.
